ITEM 1 | Bright red watermelon-like flesh in several irregular wedges and chunks, about 2-4 cm across and 1.5-2 cm thick, with a slightly moist, juicy sheen and firm edges; clustered in the upper-left of the plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Small, dark blue-black glossy spheres about 1.5 cm across, smooth skin, five pieces scattered on the right side and one near the center-bottom | 9
ITEM 3 | Pale yellow cubes about 1.5-2 cm with matte, slightly grainy surface and cut edges, piled in a loose group on the lower-left, some with a faint orange tint | 45
ITEM 4 | Pale orange-tan cubes about 2 cm with a smooth, slightly glossy, firm surface, grouped center-right next to the yellow cubes | 55
ITEM 5 | Deep red-purple skinned slice about 4 x 2.5 cm and 1.5 cm thick, with a dark skin edge and a lighter flesh interior, sitting at the bottom-center of the plate | 30
ITEM 6 | Thin, dark brown curved sliver about 2 cm long at the left edge of the plate, dry-looking with slight texture | 2
ITEM 7 | Scattered tiny light-brown crumbs and specks, dry and dusty, mostly near the top and bottom edges of the plate | 3
